buffer_pool_deposits.description: For each project, this column aggregates buffer pool credits deposited across all issuance years. Values take into account buffer pool adjustments, such as when credits are transitioned between registries and when buffer pool credits are returned to the project as issuances. Credits used to cover reversals are not deducted from this buffer pool tally.

buffer_pool_release.description: Total buffer credits returned to the project developer as issuances. E.g. VCS allows some buffer credits to be converted into issuances over time for projects that never experience a reversal.

buffer_pool_reversal_coverage.description: Total buffer pool credits used in compensation for a reversal by the project.

buffer_pool_reversal_non_coverage.description: Issued credits used in compensation for a reversal by the project. Most registries do not allow for the buffer pool to cover intentional reversals—losses caused by events under the control of the project proponent. All reversals listed in this column need to be replaced by the project proponent.

project_risk.description: A nested tree structure to provide a flexible way to store risk data in machine readable format for v1.0 in a way that does not require the large task of normalising all risk documentation across all registries and methodologies into a single schema. Implemented as a JSON format dictionary and stored as a string, this structure can be used to further nest data into sub-categories to support experimentation with structuring, before constraining the fields and types in a full risk schema in later versions. v1.0 recommends (but does not require) the keys: "natural risks", "political risks", "business risks", "legal risks" and "performance risks"

agreement_type.description: Primary classification of each financial agreement. Equity financing: investor takes an ownership stake in the project in exchange for capital. Debt financing: Capital provided as a loan to the developer, repaid with interest over time. Offtake agreement: A contract committing a buyer to purchase a defined volume of carbon credits from a project at a set (or formula-based) price once the credits are issued. Forward purchase: A buyer pays upfront (or in tranches) for credits to be delivered in the future. Revenue share: investor receives a percentage of the project's credit sale proceeds in exchange for capital or services, rather than fixed repayment or equity. Grant: Non-repayable funding provided by a donor, government, or philanthropic body, usually tied to eligibility criteria or reporting obligations but not to financial returns. Guarantee: a commitment by a third party (e.g., insurer) to cover losses or obligations if the project fails to perform.

offtake_agreement_contracted_credit_volu.description: Volume of carbon credits contracted in the offtake agreement in tCO₂e. Required when agreement_type is forward_purchase or offtake_agreement.

offtake_agreement_contracted_credit_pric.description: Agreed price per tCO₂e of credits in offtake_agreement_contracted_credit_volume. Optional when agreement_type is forward_purchase or offtake_agreement, otherwise not applicable.

offtake_agreement_credit_vintage_start.description: Earliest vintage year (ISO 8601 year) of credits eligible for delivery under this agreement. Optional when agreement_type is forward_purchase or offtake_agreement, otherwise not applicable.

offtake_agreement_credit_vintage_end.description: Latest vintage year (ISO 8601 year) of credits eligible for delivery under this agreement. Optional when agreement_type is forward_purchase or offtake_agreement, otherwise not applicable.

offtake_agreement_credit_requirements.description: Freeform text describing requirements (quality, certification) of credits eligible for delivery under this agreement. Optional when agreement_type is forward_purchase or offtake_agreement, otherwise not applicable.

agreement_effective_date.description: ISO 8601 date on which the financial arrangement became legally binding

agreement_expiry_date.description: ISO 8601 date on which the arrangement is scheduled to expire or be repaid, if applicable

agreement_commitment_amount.description: Committed amount by a counterparty organisation, in the financial agreement (USD)

agreement_insurance_policy_exists.description: Whether an insurance policy is in place for this agreement.

agreement_insurer_name.description: Name of the insurer organisation. Required when agreement_insurance_policy_exists is true

agreement_insurance_policy_reference.description: Policy number or reference ID of the insurance policy.

agreement_insurance_coverage_type.description: What the insurance policy covers. Non-delivery: protection against under or non-delivery of future carbon credits. Non-payment: protection against the risk of non-payment under project finance, prepayment facilities, offtake receivables and other credit exposures. Counterparty: protection against project failure risk, such as the counterparty abandoning the project or becoming insolvent, such that future credits cannot be delivered. Buffer_depletion: protection against unexpectedly high loss levels threatening buffer integrity. Political_risk: protection against broad political uncertainties that may affect project implementation.

agreement_currency.description: ISO 4217 alphabetic currency code in which the financial agreement is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP)

items.description: Name or identifier of the marketplace, exchange, or trading venue through which credits under this agreement are to be traded or settled.
Type of assets pledged as security (e.g., Land Title, Carbon Rights, Equipment, None).

project_financing_stage.description: Current financing stage of the project.

agreement_governing_law.description: Governing law specified in the financial agreement.

funding_source_category.description: Category of the funding source for this agreement, such as equity, grant, debt, prepayment, sponsor support, or other.

funding_source_expected_disbursement_dat.description: Expected date on which funds under this agreement will be disbursed or become available to the project. Use ISO 8601 date format.

funding_source_disbursement_schedule.description: Freeform description of how funding will be released, for example upfront, milestone-based, quarterly, on delivery, or subject to approval steps.

funding_conditions_precedent.description: Freeform description of any conditions that must be satisfied before the counterparty is legally or practically required to provide funds, such as due diligence, board approval, registration, permitting, or verification milestones.

funding_is_fully_committed.description: Whether the funding under this agreement is fully committed and binding, rather than indicative, under discussion, or subject to major unresolved conditions.

funding_commitment_status.description: Status of the funding commitment. Signed: agreement has been executed by all parties; funding is contractually committed. Awarded: formal decision has been made to allocate funding to the project, but has not yet been implemented. Approval subject to conditions: funding body has agreed in principle, but disbursement is contingent on the project meeting specified requirements (e.g. due diligence, co-financing, regulatory approval). Under negotiation: Terms are actively being discussed between the project and the funder; no commitment has been made and the outcome is uncertain. Indicative only: funder has expressed non-binding interest or provided a preliminary figure; no formal process has been initiated and the commitment carries no obligation. Rejected: funder has declined to provide funding; the application or proposal was unsuccessful. Concluded: previously active funding arrangement has run its course and been formally closed out (disbursements complete, obligations fulfilled or terminated).

funding_commitment_status_reason.description: The reason for updating the unit status

is_current.description: False for previous statuses, True for the current status.
